account_adds.en: Widening over courses and steps, not one person's present set; what a course keeps reachable.

source_adds.en: Functionings valued by reasons, and well-being as what they are for. 07's RP alone mentions 'resources or capabilities', in passing.

name.en: Sen: the process aspect of freedom

source.work: A. Sen, Rationality and Freedom (2002); Development as Freedom (1999)
source.locator: Rationality and Freedom, introductory ch. and chs. 20 to 21; locators from memory

sense.en: Freedom has an opportunity aspect, what one can achieve, and a process aspect, how it comes about. Being forced to do what one would have chosen differs from choosing it, even at the same outcome; opportunity alone misses this.

reading.en: Widening reads only what is admitted. Under the priority of basic conditions alternatives realizing the same claims compare alike, unless the acting part is adjoined as a claim. That is Sen's objection, in the account's own terms. A reading in 05 does judge a reform by who decides next round, and it is a historical correspondence, no law. [AI reading]

says.en: Conditional (J1/J2): 'alternatives realizing the same claims are compared alike'; adjoined as a basic claim, the acting formation's part orders them. 'Neither which is worse nor that the acting part is basic is shown.'
Reading [AI, D65; a historical correspondence, no theorem]: 'a reform is judged by who decides admission, comparison and correction next round'.

account_adds.en: The exact point at which the comparison goes blind, and what would adjoin it.

source_adds.en: Process as a value in itself; agency as distinct from well-being. J4's 'legitimate feasible choice' is a premise, not this.

name.en: Sen: adapted preferences misreport deprivation

source.work: A. Sen, Commodities and Capabilities (1985); On Ethics and Economics (1987)
source.locator: locator unverified; the hopeless beggar and tamed housewife passages

sense.en: People long deprived come to want little and take pleasure in small mercies, so a metric of desire or happiness reads their condition as fine. Their reports are formed by what they suffer and cannot serve alone as the measure of it.

reading.en: A reading formed from what the selection has done reads the share, not what lies beyond it; a loss so unread leaves the loop as it was. Endorsement is not authorization. That the readers are minds is a reading; the law says nothing of persons, and 'no law says a loss is a harm'. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D65]: 'Later endorsement cannot authorize the formation that produced it.'

Theorem (any type): where neither the next share nor the rule read reads the beyond (`Unread`), courses alike in share and rule stay alike; 'a change of the reading of any size is absorbed' where the reading too is formed monotonically from the share. Not shown: that any actual rule is so formed.
Premise D, not asserted: 'every position with access to a response securing new living content has a contributory reason for it, whatever its endorsement'.

account_adds.en: The exact premise under which the reading moves nothing.

source_adds.en: What to read instead: capability. The account's answer is a reading of what lies beyond the share, by whoever reads it.

name.en: Sen: choice does not reveal welfare; commitment

source.work: A. Sen, 'Behaviour and the Concept of Preference' (1973); 'Rational Fools' (1977)
source.locator: as named

sense.en: Consistency of choice yields a binary relation and no measure of welfare. Commitment, acting against one's own expected welfare, drives a wedge between choice and welfare; a person reduced to a preference ordering is a rational fool.

reading.en: The law on choices stops where Sen does: what acts show is a shown relation and its reach, and nothing whose good it is. 07's separations of warrant, recognition and motivation carry the wedge in words. The account has no commitment as a kind. 08's 'Sen (1977)' is not clearly this paper. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root; no premise; near-definitional): the choices show `x` above `y` where `x` was chosen while `y` was open; the positive comparisons every such order shares are exactly the shown reach.
AI reading: 'Motivation is apart: that a loss counts from one's standpoint moves no one by itself.'

account_adds.en: Revealed preference on the root, with what no choice data separates.

source_adds.en: Commitment as a distinct ground of action, and the several concepts 'preference' confounds.

name.en: Sen: maximal choice, comparative justice

source.work: A. Sen, 'Maximization and the Act of Choice' (1997); The Idea of Justice (2009)
source.locator: Idea of Justice, Introduction and ch. 4

sense.en: Reasoned choice does not need a complete ranking: pick an option not worse than any other. Justice needs comparison of feasible alternatives and no account of the perfect arrangement. Incompleteness may be assertive, and is not a defect.

reading.en: C has the first half: it decides no mixed comparison. The maximal route is stated: with the comparison weakly decided on the menu an undefeated option exists, and L leaves a response with one good and one bad outcome incomparable both ways. These are laws of choice, not ethics: the choosing rests on J1/J2 beside the condition for scope and C for order, none asserted. Whether J1's 'complete comparison' asks a complete order, the gloss does not settle. [AI reading]

says.en: 'On a reading of `living`, C ranks a course above each course it extends there ... and decides no other pair'; 'Choices take more, following from neither the condition nor C'.

Calibration: 'That every nonempty listed set of options at a frame's step, under an irreflexive transitive comparison, has an undefeated option is exactly weak excluded middle'; 'with the comparison weakly decided on the menu the option exists (`Requirement.frontier_exists`)'. L: 'a response with one good and one bad outcome is incomparable both ways.'
Premises as named at P-21: J1–J4: 'complete comparison with retained losses, priority of basic conditions, bounded responsibility, legitimate feasible choice', each a hypothesis where used.

account_adds.en: A calibration: that every nonempty listed menu has an undefeated option is exactly weak excluded middle.

source_adds.en: Comparative justice against an account of the perfect arrangement, and assertive incompleteness: a judgment that two are not comparable, not a gap in information.

name.en: Sen: the impossibility of a Paretian liberal

source.work: A. Sen, 'The Impossibility of a Paretian Liberal' (1970)
source.locator: article as a whole

sense.en: Unrestricted domain, weak Pareto and a minimal liberty for each person over a personal sphere cannot all hold in a social choice with no cycle. Unanimity can conflict with even minimal rights.

reading.en: The account's unanimity is on admission, not preferences, so the theorem does not transfer directly. Its relevant line is narrower: a study's words in P-24, that a constraint against closing never conflicts with C. Whether a personal sphere, read as a claim, can conflict with widening is not asked. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: A proved limit on unanimity plus liberty. A study names it (foundation-assessment/GOVERNANCE-LITERATURE.md), and ig-integration-gaps/GAP-MAP.md §6.1 flags it, with Arrow, as unstated. P-04's question on rights and constraints is where it would go.

read: 07 what the chapter does not show

name.en: Sen: positional objectivity

source.work: A. Sen, 'Positional Objectivity', Philosophy & Public Affairs 22 (1993)
source.locator: article as a whole

sense.en: What one observes depends on one's position, yet observation from a position is interpersonally checkable by anyone who takes it. Objectivity need not be a view from nowhere; a positional view can still be mistaken as a trans-positional claim.

reading.en: 07 and 03 stand near: 'objectivity is answerability to the relations a judgment concerns across differences of access', knowers inside the unfolding, and de se apart from de dicto. Assessment standing, no law. The account has no check of a positional claim by taking the same position. [AI reading]

says.en: Assessment, continuity and objectivity: 'Objectivity is answerability to the relations a judgment concerns across differences of access, not consensus; shared inquiry adds checks only where they are differently vulnerable'.
'Knowing, modelling and criticizing happen inside it too, so their adequacy is part of the inquiry, not a vantage outside it.'

Theorem (any type): where each witness added copies one on the roster, inspection gives the same certificate; 'That a witness merely agreeing with another, without copying it, adds nothing is not shown.'

account_adds.en: The law of copied witnesses: checks count only where differently vulnerable.

source_adds.en: Positional illusion as a named error, and the transposition test.

changes.why: Added the passing law, a closer form than the record's one line: a society's members inherit its defining form, and `Web.ByPassing` says what carries a pattern was given it by a carrier. It is a premise there, and the entry says so.

The mapper read reading-off as immanence. Whitehead sets immanence apart from mere description as well as from imposition, and a law read off a history is nearer the description. The agreement holds only against imposition, and the entry now says so.

Relation scope and carried changed overstated it: the law on novelty's gain reads an amount and his novelty is none, so no scope is given, and no live page takes up his claim. Fresh reading, divergence.
Kept the reading. Replaced 'P1 to P4, none shown', which goes beyond 07: T8 names P2 and P4 as what needs argument and calls P1 the self's presupposition.
Read both 08 passages: the forbidden explanations and the two live arguments are as quoted. The doubt about eternal objects is marked as the reader's own.
The mapper missed it: 01 and 08 define 'internal' in the account's own sense, and this is the claim of Whitehead's that word invites comparing with.

Read 08's commitments row, the record's line and 01 §1: as quoted. The test holds, and the reply from discrete steps does keep instants. The study's reading of Creative Evolution ch. 1 checks at the line cited.
Read 07 §2's reading and 08's beyond-the-table lines: the concession on what cannot be prestated stands there. Contrary reading fits, since he argues against the very form the comparison uses.
T8 and 04's thesis are as quoted, both premises named. No mechanism joins them, and the entry says so.
Kept the reading, which is a strong test of §4.6. Replaced 'none shown' for P1 to P4, and named route (b), since 'enlightened' is the dossier's word (P-13), not 07's.

Not-carried stands. Added another sense of the word the mapper did not list (`RecognitionalBinding` in 08 §6 concerns reference and support) and the shared-code law, which forms no self, to the evidence.
Added copied witnesses, a nearer law for 'a reader who depends on you confirms nothing', with its own limit. Structural agreement only.

Two corrections. The lord need not depend at all: 05's clearing witness says so, and it is the sharper denial of his premise. And the LA2 line blurred the result: 02's T7 text says the frozen verdicts passed and the conjecture failed for that judge.

The mapper missed it. 05 has a law of position and lists as conjecture the ends of races for it, one of them a frozen mutual destruction: the account's closest material to the struggle, and a clear place it parts from mutual recognition.
Reading kept. Pointed the second target at the section's own anchor, `r-self-reference-does-not-certify-itself`.

Carried-in-part was wrong: the live record states none of his deduction, only that a comparison separates a category from a causal mechanism. That is the account saying something else: changed. Added 08's passage from inclusion to relation.

Split. The mapper's relation scope did not fit: Marx's claim is about one historical form, not universal. Its carriers half has a form the mapper missed, the passing law and 02's 传, so this entry is now agreement on that half, with the open question copied. Expansion without end moved to its own entry, since the mapper's 'no quantity whose growth is the point' overlooks 03's seeking boundary.

The mapper's source_adds said the account has no quantity whose growth is the point of the loop. 02 §9 and 03 state a target needing ever more: a close form for M-C-M', with a limit the entry can state.
Read the theorem's full statement: the form holds, and the caveats (value read as a conserved amount, near-definitional accounting, no source named) are the right ones.
Added 05 §10's hypothetical of the maintenance-deferring provider, the account's nearest case to a capitalist compelled by competition; it is labelled a hypothetical reading.
'Unmet on any field case' misreported T1: it passed on some frozen settings and failed on others, and 08's row says 'no field test of a need measured in advance'. Copied that.

Named the word trap: 'intrinsic value' in 08 is not Marx's value. Dropped the target's line on the wording of money, a rule of vocabulary with no mechanism. What stays is the form of a relation read as a property, as a rule of explanation only.
Not-carried stands. The market model's line 'adds no mathematical advantage' is at 08 §8, not 05 §10; corrected, and the evidence list is now what this reader read.
Source corrected: 'gravediggers' is the Manifesto and 'the movement abolishing the present state of things' is The German Ideology, neither of the works the mapper cited. The reading stands.
Added 08's own statement that treating carrier equality as the representation's is 'not shown': it is what the contrary reading presses on.
Added 01's sense of 'internal' as the account's nearest statement; its limit is the point of contrast.

History-only stands. Did what the mapper had not: checked PLAN §4.4, which lists bistability and transitions between regions, none of a structure spreading from a seed. Added 05's law that selection does not create an absent practice, the nearest statement about forming.

Sharpened from 07's summary to the laws themselves. `SharedCodes.shared_iff_in_use` and 'hearing makes no form' state exactly what he denies for a collective, and coining is the account's one route to something new, so it had to be named.

Relation changed to divergence: an unconditional duty against what is given only under a hypothesis, from a standpoint, is the brief's own definition of it. Flagged that the record's gloss 'the existence of the whole' is wider than his object, which P-05 states as human life.
Read 07 §1 at the limit theorem and the sentence after it: the non-entailment is of the represented dynamics, as the entry says, and it does not refute him.
04's reading and the fed-from-beyond theorem are as quoted, with the whole-unit premise in 'it can fail'. The withheld half is the right line to draw.

Carried-in-part was wrong: a law on what need reaches states no part of his claim about duty. Fresh reading. Added 07 §3.4's reading, which counts further living formation with no existing beneficiary and invents no duty: the closest statement and the sharpest contrast.
Not-carried stands after looking where a rule might hide: the chance floor is a law of masses, E is a premise on every admitted continuation, and neither ranks the worse prognosis first.

Scope claimed the account says where conatus holds; it does not. It leaves open which formations are centers, and he fills that by asserting a nature of each thing, so this is divergence, with the part carried being the centers' wanting.
All three targets are as quoted, and the entry gives his likely reply.
08 does not name him, as the entry says. The distance at the whole stands: the thesis forbids a self with a nature of its own.
Read both net cases in 08 and 01 §9.10: as quoted. A contrary reading; it presses on what the comparison of courses needs.
07 §1's sentences and ONE-PAGE's line are as quoted. Both distances are real, and the two premises are named.
Carried-in-part overstated it: the feeding law states nothing of agreement in nature under reason, and no live page has his claim. Fresh reading, keeping scope.

Relation to divergence: he argues for what 07 states as a premise 'coherently denied'. Corrected 'a line under a class is coarser than R': P-18 says descent does not carry R, which is another thing. Added the need-with-time record's direct comparison with him.
Read the witness in the record and the own-good record: as quoted. The second half is rightly left to no law.

Carried was too strong: 07 applies the claim to a self stretched downstream, and his claim is about one's own future under Reductionism. Added the record that binds Wolf's form of it to a declaration.
08's row and P-07 are as quoted; C's stronger first step and its silence on the later steps stand.
The theorem is as quoted, with its premises and the 08 verdict. The law states no theory defeated.
The mapper missed it: the record joint-difference-making names Parfit on collective harm as its comparison, the one Parfit correspondence outside identity and priority that the laws actually state.
Both records are as quoted. Thin, and the entry says so: the two-neutralities shape is the reader's, and the chapter does not state it.
T5 and its standing are as quoted; the convergence is far narrower than his, as the entry says.
08's sentences are as quoted. Scope fits: shown of what is represented, argued of the theory, and of reality not at all.
08's measure of the thesis is as quoted. The divergence is the reader's, labelled, and worth keeping: a named neighbour would refuse the neighbourhood.
Attribution fixed: 'a correspondence not proved here' is the record's sentence, not 01's, so the target now names the record. 01 itself says 'analogues not proved here'.
Named among 08's neighbours, so kept though outside the frame. Read the calibration, the record and the sentence on triviality: as quoted.

Carried was too strong, by the brief's 'at the same scope': the account has the finite, two-valued case with natural weights, and any class from the positive weightings up. His approach takes any admissible set of weights over any real-valued welfare.
Scope did not fit: nothing here corrects a universal form of his. The shape is shared, but what he asserts (a person's reasons to value, public reasoning) the account does not, so divergence.
The conditional and its 'Neither which is worse...' are as quoted, and 05's reading is labelled a historical correspondence. The objection in the account's own terms is fair.
The D65 sentence, the closed-capture law with its Not shown, and premise D are as quoted. The caveat on minds stays.
The law stops where the entry says. Whether 08's 'Sen (1977)' is this paper remains flagged, under not_mapped.

The mapper's 'No law here takes the maximal route' is false: 07 §5 chooses an undefeated option, with `Requirement.frontier_exists` and a calibration of what it needs, and L leaves pairs incomparable. So agreement, in part, and the question of completeness moves to what J1's gloss means.
History-only stands. Replaced a line number with the section, and said how little of each study was read.
The account_adds cited the copied-witness law without a target; added it, with its limit.
